_comment: Asset concept specs for the MILLION DEAD pipeline. Coordinates: +Y up, model faces +Z, metres, origin on the ground under the centre. Budgets from shared/specs/mesh_format.md; palette and silhouettes from shared/specs/art_direction.md.

scuttler.emissive_hint: the eye cluster on the front of the wedge head
scuttler.prompt: Ultra low poly faceted four-legged alien crawler, like a flat armoured tick on four legs: a very low, flat, wide body made of a few large angular chitin plates, a sharp flat wedge-shaped head pointing straight forward, exactly four thick angular legs, one at each corner of the body like a table, splayed far out sideways, a pale bone-coloured ridge down the middle of the back, two glowing orange eyes on the front of the wedge head. Only four legs in total. No antennae, no mandibles, no tail. Colours: dark graphite grey carapace, gunmetal grey legs, pale bone ridge, glowing orange eyes, nothing else. Large flat planes, hard edges, no greebles. Standing neutral pose, facing forward, single creature, no base, no pedestal, no ground.
scuttler.negative_prompt: spider, six legs, eight legs, antennae, mandibles, tail, wings, tall body, round smooth body, pedestal, base, ground plane, humanoid, fur, hair, text

stalker.emissive_hint: the eyes on the front of the head
stalker.prompt: Ultra low poly faceted alien stalker, a lean insectoid predator like a praying mantis crossed with a raptor: it stands on two digitigrade reverse-knee legs bent backwards like a bird's, its narrow body hunched forward, and its two forearms are huge long flat scythe blades, each as long as its legs, held forward and down. A narrow wedge-shaped head with glowing orange eyes, a row of pale bone spikes along the hunched back. Colours: dark graphite grey chitin, gunmetal grey joints, pale bone blades and spikes, glowing orange eyes only. Large flat angular planes, hard edges, no greebles. Standing neutral pose, facing forward, single creature, no base, no pedestal, no ground.
stalker.negative_prompt: gorilla, ape, humanoid, bulky, fat, robot, hands, fingers, small claws, tail, wings, pedestal, base, ground plane, fur, hair, wires, text, bright colours

seeker.emissive_hint: the large lens eye on the front of the body
seeker.prompt: Ultra low poly faceted floating alien sentinel eye: a single round armoured sphere hovering in the air, one big glowing orange lens on its front, one large flat angular ring standing vertically around the sphere like a gimbal, and four short flat blade fins at the back of the sphere pointing backwards. Nothing hangs below it: no legs, no spikes underneath. Colours: dark graphite grey shell, gunmetal grey ring, pale bone fins, glowing orange lens only. Large flat angular planes, hard edges, no greebles. Hovering, facing forward, single object, no base, no pedestal, no stand, no ground.
seeker.negative_prompt: legs, feet, spikes underneath, tentacles, arms, stand, pedestal, base, ground plane, cables, wires, text, bright colours

colossus.emissive_hint: the glowing core in the armoured chest, front
colossus.prompt: Ultra low poly faceted colossal alien siege beast that walks on four legs, like a giant armoured tortoise-elephant: a long horizontal armoured body carried on four thick pillar legs, one at each corner, a tall stepped siege-tower structure of angular armour plates rising from the middle of its back, a low armoured head at the front, and one large glowing red core set in the front of its chest under the head. Colours: dark graphite grey armour plates, gunmetal grey legs and tower, pale bone ridges, glowing red core only. Huge flat angular planes, hard edges, no greebles. Standing neutral pose, facing forward, single creature, not a robot, not humanoid, no base, no pedestal, no ground, no riders.
colossus.negative_prompt: humanoid, robot, mech, bipedal, two legs, arms, hands, standing upright, riders, people, pedestal, base, ground plane, flags, cloth, wires, text, bright colours

hero.emissive_hint: the visor across the front of the helmet
hero.prompt: Ultra low poly faceted lone armoured warrior with a distinctive silhouette: oversized angular shoulder plates much wider than the body, a narrow waist, sturdy legs, a closed angular helmet with a single horizontal glowing cyan visor slit across the front, holding a long heavy rifle-like energy weapon diagonally across the chest with both hands, barrel pointing up and forward. Gunmetal grey armour, pale bone armour trim on the shoulder plates and chest, dark graphite undersuit at the joints, glowing cyan visor only. Large flat angular planes, hard edges, no greebles. Standing neutral pose, facing forward, single figure, no base, no pedestal, no ground, no cape, no cloth.
hero.negative_prompt: space marine, power armour mascot, bulky robot, mech, cape, cloth, hair, face, wires, pedestal, base, ground plane, text, bright colours

monolith.emissive_hint: a vertical seam of light on the front face
monolith.prompt: Ultra low poly faceted alien monolith: a tall angular slab of dark stone-like alien material, slightly tapered and bent, carved with a few large chitin-like plates, a single narrow vertical seam of glowing orange light on its front face, bone-coloured ribs at its edges. Colours: dark graphite grey, gunmetal grey, pale bone ribs, glowing orange seam only. Large flat planes, hard edges, no greebles. Single object, no base platform, no ground.

pylon.prompt: Ultra low poly faceted ruined industrial power pylon: a broken steel lattice tower made of a few thick angular beams, bent and snapped near the top, rusted. Colours: gunmetal grey steel, dark graphite grey, rust brown oxide patches. Large flat planes, thick beams, hard edges, no thin wires, no cables, no greebles. Single object, no ground, no base platform.
